FXCollaborative is an established architectural, interior design, planning, and urban design firm based in Brooklyn, NY. Noted for its commitment to sustainable design, the firm has been recognized through local, national, and international design excellence awards and feature articles in the most prestigious design publications. The practice encompasses corporate, civic, cultural, educational, transportation, residential, hospitality, office, retail, and mixed-use projects on a variety of scales.
We are currently accepting applications for talented Project Architects.
Position Responsibilities:
- Lead all phases of the design process with a high level of proficiency and expertise.
- Facilitate firm and project goals of excellence in design, execution, and sustainability.
- Coordinate project documentation execution, construction plans, and details while ensuring quality control and completion.
- Understand and respond to technical implications and design decisions.
- Direct production of schematic, design development, and construction documents in collaboration with Project Managers.
- Review shop drawings, material samples, and construction documents for conformance with design.
- Assure execution of agency review analysis (accessibility, zoning, life-safety, etc.).
- Review work for accuracy, omissions, legibility, and for document compliance.
- May establish architectural budgets, task schedules, and other components of the project work plan with the Project Managers.
- Implement meeting objectives, facilitate meetings, and provide documentation in collaboration with the Project Managers.
- Mentor staff and provide oversight of assignments.
- Be accountable for effective coordination with partners, clients, and consultants.
Position Requirements:
- 10+ years of related professional experience. 
- Registered Architects preferred.
- LEED accredited preferred.
- A graduate of an accredited Masters or Bachelor of Architecture degree program or related combination.
- Candidates should have strong design skills as well as excellent written and verbal communications skills.
- Strong technical skills including proficiency with Revit, SketchUp, Enscape, Bluebeam, AutoCAD, Adobe Creative Suite, and other related design software.
 
If you are interested in the Project Architect position, please submit your application online here.
